name: ME 5215
title: Underwater Sensor Systems Analysis and Design
description: The Underwater Sensor Systems Analysis and Design course explores the analysis and synthesis of underwater sensing and communication systems. The intended applications of these systems and the factors that affects their performances in various environmental conditions. Size, weight, and cost provide the constraints to achieve the optimized (or compromised) design.
requirement_description: Undergraduate courses in Calculus Based Physics; MATLAB or equivalent for computer simulations; or Underwater Acoustics and Sensing Systems.
